description: Generates an AI video from a prompt (or from a start image). Takes a few minutes — the tool waits (up to 10 min) and returns a link to the mp4 file. Video is the most expensive operation: it spends the model's credit price (see fattly_list_models), so confirm the model and cost with the user first. Credits are refunded automatically if the generation fails.

inputImageUrl.description: Optional start image for image-to-video — must be a fal URL. Get one by uploading a local photo with fattly_upload_image.

model.description: Video model id (default kling-3-standard), e.g. kling-3-pro, veo-3-1, veo-3-1-fast, seedance-2-5, hailuo-3, ltx-2-5. Full list with prices: fattly_list_models.

name: fattly_generate_video
title: Generate a video
